```{r}
# Define directories
filtered_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/results_unzipped/meta_clinvar_core_csv"
am_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/all_AM"
output_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/results_unzipped/meta_clinvar_core_csv_with_am"

# List all filtered ClinVar CSV files
filtered_files <- list.files(filtered_dir, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(filtered_files) #17524
head(filtered_files)

# List all am CSV files and create a mapping of UniProt IDs
am_files <- list.files(am_dir, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
am_map <- setNames(am_files, str_replace(basename(am_files), ".csv$", ""))

# Process each filtered ClinVar CSV file
for (file in filtered_files) {
  # Extract UniProt ID from the filename
  uniprot_id <- str_replace(basename(file), "_filtered.csv$", "")
  
  print(paste("Processing:", uniprot_id))
  
  # Read filtered ClinVar CSV file
  df_clinvar <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Find the corresponding am file
  if (uniprot_id %in% names(am_map)) {
    am_file <- am_map[[uniprot_id]]
    df_am <- read.csv(am_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_am <- df_am %>% dplyr::rename(variant = protein_variant)
    
    # Merge am scores with the filtered ClinVar data
    df_merged <- df_clinvar %>%
      left_join(df_am, by = "variant")  # Ensure correct merging by variant
    
    print(paste("Merged AM data for:", uniprot_id))
  } else {
    
    df_merged <- df_clinvar
    print(paste("No am file found for:", uniprot_id))
  }
  
  # Save the merged file
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(uniprot_id, "_filtered_with_am.csv"))
  write.csv(df_merged, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  print(paste("Saved:", output_file))
}

print("All files processed successfully.")

outfile_list <- list.files(path = output_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = FALSE)
length(outfile_list) #17524
```

```{r}
# Set up parallelization
future::plan(multisession)

# Define paths
input_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/results_unzipped/meta_clinvar_core_csv_with_am"
output_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/results_unzipped/AM_results/core_lm_rds"

# Function to process each protein file
process_protein <- function(file_path, output_dir) {
  # Define a small constant for clamping, similar to what's implied in the second function
  # The actual value of 'epsilon' should be defined/available in the environment
  # For demonstration, let's assume a small value, or you should ensure 'epsilon' is defined globally.
  # If epsilon is not defined, we'll use a standard small number like 1e-6.
  epsilon <- 1e-10
  
  # Extract protein ID from filename
  protein_id <- gsub("\\_core_with_am.csv$", "", basename(file_path))
  
  # Read data
  protein_data <- tryCatch(fread(file_path), error = function(e) {
    message("Error reading file: ", file_path)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(protein_data) || nrow(protein_data) == 0) {
    message("Skipping empty or unreadable file: ", file_path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Ensure required columns exist
  required_columns <- c("variant", "ddG_pred", "am_pathogenicity") # Note: ESM.1v is no longer required for the LM
  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(protein_data))) {
    # It seems the original function also required ESM.1v, so we'll keep it for the original saveRDS column list
    # but the LM only requires am_pathogenicity and ddG_pred.
    required_columns_full <- c("variant", "ddG_pred", "am_pathogenicity")
    if (!all(required_columns_full %in% names(protein_data))) {
       message("Skipping file due to missing columns: ", file_path)
       return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Clamp AM scores and compute logits (as done in the second function)
  # The column is assumed to be 'am_pathogenicity' based on the required_columns check.
  protein_data[, am_clamped := pmin(pmax(am_pathogenicity, epsilon), 1 - epsilon)]
  protein_data[, am_logit := log(am_clamped / (1 - am_clamped))]
  
  ### Linear Model (LM)
  # Change: Use am_logit as the response variable
  lm_fit <- tryCatch({
    lm(am_logit ~ ddG_pred, data = protein_data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LM failed for protein: ", protein_id, " - ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (!is.null(lm_fit)) {
    # Add predictions to the data frame
    # Change: Update predicted column name
    protein_data[, predicted_am_logit_lm := predict(lm_fit, newdata = protein_data)]
    
    # Save LM results
    lm_results <- list(
      fit = lm_fit,
      r_squared = summary(lm_fit)$r.squared,
      adjusted_r_squared = summary(lm_fit)$adj.r.squared,
      # Change: Update predicted_data columns to include am_pathogenicity and am_logit
      predicted_data = protein_data[, .(variant, ddG_pred, am_pathogenicity, am_logit, predicted_am_logit_lm)]
    )
    saveRDS(lm_results, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0(protein_id, "_lm.rds")))
  }
  
  # Return a summary of the results
  return(list(protein_id = protein_id, lm_success = !is.null(lm_fit)))
}

# Get the list of CSV files
file_list <- list.files(path = input_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
length(file_list) #17524

# Process 
results <- future_lapply(file_list, process_protein, output_dir = output_dir)

# Summarize results
results_dt <- rbindlist(results, fill = TRUE)
results_dt
table(results_dt$lm_success)
```

```{r}
length(rds_files) #17519

extract_r_squared <- function(file) {
  protein_id <- sub("_lm.rds$", "", basename(file))
  
  adj_r2 <- tryCatch({
    lm_rds <- readRDS(file)
    lm_rds$adjusted_r_squared
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", file, ":", e$message))
    NA
  })
  
  data.table(protein_id = protein_id, adj_r2 = adj_r2)
}

all_r2 <- rbindlist(lapply(rds_files, extract_r_squared), fill = TRUE)
nrow(all_r2) #17519

sum(!is.na(all_r2$adj_r2))  #17519
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
r2_combined <- bind_rows(
  all_var_r2 %>% mutate(source = "All"),
  core_var_r2 %>% mutate(source = "Core")
)

#min(all_var_r2$adj_r2) #-0.004163465

# Count summaries - 20139
n_all <- length(unique(all_var_r2$protein_id))
n_var_all <- 195693294 

n_core <- length(unique(core_var_r2$protein_id))
n_var_core <- 47982923

# Median R²s
med_all <- median(all_var_r2$adj_r2, na.rm = TRUE) #0.2749491
med_core <- median(core_var_r2$adj_r2) #0.1802369

# Rename column to standardize
r2_combined <- r2_combined  %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("All", "Core")))

p1 <- ggplot(r2_combined, aes(x = source, y = adj_r2, fill = source)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, color = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, color = "grey", alpha = 0.7) +
  #stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, color = "black", fatten = 1) +
  geom_point(stat = "summary", fun = median, shape = 18, size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("Median R²: ", round(..y.., 3))),
            stat = "summary", fun = median, vjust = -1, size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.87, label = paste0(n_all, " proteins\n", format(n_var_all, big.mark = ","), " variants"), size = 4.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.87, label = paste0(n_core, " proteins\n", format(n_var_core, big.mark = ","), " variants"), size = 4.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "Human Proteome",
    subtitle = paste(n_all, "proteins"),
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("R² between ddGf and AlphaMissense logits")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("skyblue1", "steelblue3")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


ggsave("/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/git_allostery_pathogenicity/figs/revision/fig1_r2.pdf", plot = p1, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 500)
```

```{r}
# Vector of UniProt prefixes
ids <- unique(c("P48052", "O00257", "P31689", "P29323", "Q00688", "Q5VST9",
                "Q8TE49", "Q13526", "O75400", "P54725", "O94993" ,"O95155", "O95071"))

# Source directory (where your CSVs live)
src_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/00.human_proteome_unzipped/all_AM"

# Destination directory
dest_dir <- "/lustre/scratch126/gengen/projects_v2/alpha-allostery-global/allostery_pathogenicity/git_allostery_pathogenicity/data/revision/megascale_am"

# Loop over each prefix and copy matching files
for (id in ids) {
    # construct source file pattern
    files_to_copy <- list.files(src_dir, pattern = paste0("^", id, ".*\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE)

    # copy them
    file.copy(files_to_copy, dest_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
}
```
